questions.stem: A male patient presents for an elective total knee replacement. During the preoperative assessment, the anesthesiologist performs a thorough evaluation and finds: Mallampati Score: Class III Thyromental Distance: 6 cm Sterno-mental distance 13 cm with head in maximum extension Neck circumference of 16 inch Which of the following features in a patient would prompt you to anticipate a difficult intubation?

options.label: C
options.text: Sterno-mental distance 13cm with head in maximum extension
